verbetes.glosa_atual: (ὑάκινθος; די para הי ou יי para evitar o uso de letras do Tetragrama; Ar. lê ייקינטין) jacinto, uma pedra preciosa.
definicoes_originais: (ὑάκινθος; די for הי or יי to avoid the use of letters of the Tetragrammaton; Ar. reads ייקינטין) hyacinth, a precious stone.
notas_originais: Ex. R. s. 38, end לוי ד' (not דייקני') Levi was represented on the Highpriests’ breast-plate by a hyacinth (h. ברקת). Y’lamd. to Deut. X, 1, quot. in Ar. המרגליות ויי' (Yalk. ib. 854 דייקוסנין, דייקינטין, corr. acc.) the pearls and hyacinths. Gen. R. s. 79, end (after interpreting ק̇ש̇ט̇ in ק̇ש̇י̇ט̇ה̇, Gen. XXXIII, 19) what function have Yod Hé here? [read:] אלו חליות ד' וזמרגדין שדרכן וכ' (v. ‘Rashi’ a. l. a. Yalk. ib. 134) these are the links of hyacinths and smaragds with which jewelry is decorated, i.e. the vowel letters connecting the consonants, but which also have an allegorical meaning (v. the sentence following: מי כותב וכ').
Esth. R. to I, 6 (quoted as Greek translation of כרפס ib.) יקינטינון Mus. (ed. טיינון, corr. acc.); v. אלטינון.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (= h. זָכָה) [para ser claro (cmp. דְּכַךְ),]; ser limpo, puro; ser inocentado, absolvido, purificado do pecado.; ser merecedor, privilegiado, admitido (cmp. זכי).; limpar, purificar; restaurar a limpeza levítica, limpar.
definicoes_originais: (= h. זָכָה) [ to be clear (cmp. דְּכַךְ),]
to be clean, pure; to be cleared, acquitted, cleansed from sin.
to be deserving, privileged, admitted (cmp. זכי).
to clear, purify; to restore to levitical cleanness, to cleanse.
to became clean, be cleansed (from sin), be purified.
to be cleared away, be removed, be gone.
notas_originais: Targ. Lev. XII, 7 ותִדְכֵּי O. ed. Berl. (ed. ותַ' incorr., Y. ותִדְכֵי). Ib. XVI, 30 תִּדְכּוֹן O. (Y. תֵּידְכוּן). Targ. Ezek. XXIV, 13 תִדְכִּין (Nun emphat.; ed. Lag. תדכן); a. fr.

Targ. O. Deut. XXIII, 2 sq.—Targ. Ruth II, 10. Ib. 13 מִדְכֵי (sub. למיעל).—Lev. R. s. 34 [read:] זכי בי או דכי בי, v. זְכֵי.— Part. דָּכֵי, f. דַּכְיָא. Targ. Is. LXV, 5 דְּכֵינָא וכ' I am purer than &c., v. דְּכֵי. [Targ. Prov. VI, 11, v. דְּרַךְ.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Pi. דִּיכֵּן (cmp. דכך) enterrar plantas bulbosas no solo para impedir o crescimento do tubérculo (diferente de fr. ריכן, v. רָכַן).
definicoes_originais: , Pi. דִּיכֵּן (cmp. דכך) to pound bulbous plants in the ground in order to stop the growth of the tuber (differ. fr. ריכן, v. רָכַן).
notas_originais: Y. Shebi. V, 35 d bot. דִּיכְּנוֹ וכ' he crushed the tuber in the Sabbatical year and took it out after &c. [Tosef. ib. II, 10 לדכן Var., read with ed. Zuck. לרכן; cmp. Y. ib. 36 a top.]—Part. pass. מְדוּכָּן, pl. מְדוּכָּנִין. Ned. 58 a במד' it treats of onions which had been pounded in the preceding agricultural year; Y. Shebi.
